content.title: Last Time Illinois Men’s Basketball Won the National Championship
content.text: Apr 04, 2026, 2:42 PM min read (AP Photo/Michael Conroy) Illinois is a proud basketball program in a section of the Midwest that truly loves the sport. But in 121 years of Illinois basketball, the Illini have never won the national championship. All that could change this weekend. Illinois basketball odds suggest the Illini are favored to beat UConn and advance to the title game, where they’ll face the survivor of Saturday night’s Arizona vs. Michigan heavyweight showdown. Last Time Illinois Men’s Basketball Played In the National Championship Game Illinois has played in only one championship game. It was in 2005 when Deron Williams and the Illini lost to North Carolina. Last Time Illinois Men’s Basketball Made the Final Four Illinois hasn’t made the Final Four since 2005.
